name: SDF-based Volume Rendering with Laplacian CDF
definition: A method to render geometry by outputting a Signed Distance Function (SDF) value s and variance β from an MLP, then transforming s into opacity σ using a Laplacian Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF). This allows for tight surface extraction and inverse CDF sampling.
summary: SDF-based Volume Rendering with Laplacian CDF renders geometry by transforming SDF values into opacity via a Laplacian distribution, enabling efficient inverse CDF sampling and spatially varying surface tightness.
